checks.name: domain-invariant-closure
checks.summary: All 27 tests pass (16 pre-existing baseline tests unchanged plus 11 new closure tests). Invariant 1 (fencing/expiry) enumerates 9072 grid cells per function with 6 AcceptExecutionResult and 3 StartExecution success cells, all others rejected with an unmodified Execution. Invariant 2 (no side-effect permit survives an effective stop) is closed in three layers: L1 enumerates 810 Permit input cells (9 ControlMode x 10 PermitKind x 3 revision-relation x 3 fence-relation) and asserts Permit is total (err==nil iff Allowed()); within the 252 stop-mode x side-effect-kind cells, exactly 2 are allowed (the graceful-stop/PermitCheckpoint exception at exact revision) and 250 are denied. L2 performs breadth-first search over every ControlIntent sequence of length 1 to 4 over a 21-symbol alphabet (3 scopes x 7 modes), 204204 sequences and 806610 prefixes, recomputing EffectiveControl at every prefix; of 598296 stop-mode prefixes, 110622 side-effect checks are the same graceful-stop/checkpoint exception and 3479154 are denied. L3 closes the invariant unconditionally: across 5384664 direct EffectFromPermit attempts and 2399724 replay attempts (permits captured at an earlier, non-stop prefix and replayed after the stop takes effect) at every stop-mode prefix, the number of successfully constructed Effect values is exactly 0, because EffectFromPermit requires the re-read current control mode to be exactly ControlAllow independent of the PermitDecision's own Allowed() flag; this is the total function over the finite input relation that closes the claim, so the enumeration is a closure, not a sample. Invariant 3 performs breadth-first search to fixpoint over DecideRequirement (11 statuses x 9 commands): RequirementCompleted is confirmed unreachable (10 reached statuses, 29 accepted edges), every reached state has a zero StableSnapshot, CompleteRequirementFromRelease returns ErrInvalidTransition from all 10 non-evaluating statuses, ErrEvidenceIncomplete from evaluating with a zero-value proof, and RequirementCompleted with a fully cross-checked non-zero StableSnapshot from a proof produced by CompletePromotionWithProof. Forbidden transitions performs the same closure over DecideIncrement (12 statuses x 12 commands, all 12 statuses reached, 33 accepted edges) and asserts the accepted edge set equals a declared table transcribed from docs/architecture/domain-model.md section 5; both closures assert ErrStaleVersion and an unchanged state for a mismatched ExpectedVersion. Invariant 4 enumerates the full evidence-completeness product for a 3-capability release candidate (16 per-capability cases: present x Verified x Fresh x digest-agreement, cubed, crossed with RollbackEvidence x ResumeEvidence = 16384 grid cells) and confirms CanPromote succeeds for exactly 1 of 16384 cells; crossing that one fully-satisfied candidate with all 7 ControlMode values confirms PromoteRelease succeeds only under Allow and is denied with ErrControlDenied under the other 6, with no valid StableReleaseProof reachable from a denied promotion. Measured wall time for the whole ./internal/domain suite is under 0.5s, well inside the 30-second budget in docs/architecture/validation.md section 7. Running this argv three times in a row on this commit produced identical test-name/PASS-FAIL output (per-test and per-package wall-clock digits vary, as expected of a timer, but no test name, status, or count differed).
